translations.web: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t this because you are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God?
translations.bsb: Jesus said to them, “Aren’t you mistaken, because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God?
translations.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, Do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?
